newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt tenders for 25,000 to 40,000 tonnes oils.
newsitem.headline: Egypt tenders for 25,000 to 40,000 tonnes oils.

text.p: Egypt's state Holding Company for Food Industries said on Monday that it was tendering for 25,000 to 40,000 tonnes of cotton seed, sunflower seed and soya bean oils for delivery in August.
The closing date is July 16 at noon Egyptian time (0900 GMT).
The tenders were detailed as follows:
- 10,000 to 15,000 tonnes of crude sunflower seed oil and/or semi-refined cotton seed oil and/or American cottonseed oil PBSY 162 for arrival in the first half of August, 1997.
- The same amounts and types of oil for arrival in the second half of August.
- 5,000 to 10,000 tonnes of degummed soya bean oil for arrival in the second half of August.
